## `{qcthat}` generates qualification reports from your test suite

```{=html}
<div class="report-hero">
  <div class="report-shot">
    <img src="slide_images/gh_report_pr_zoom.png" alt="qcthat issue test matrix posted on a pull request: one milestone, three issues, nine passing tests">
  </div>
  <a class="release-card" href="https://github.com/Gilead-Public/qcthat/releases/latest" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
    <span class="release-card-qr"><img src="slide_images/qr_latest_release.png" alt="QR code linking to the latest qcthat release"></span>
    <span class="release-card-label">Latest release</span>
    <span class="release-card-url">Gilead-Public/qcthat/releases</span>
  </a>
</div>
```

::: notes
- We'll talk a bit later about all the reports that are available, including Milestones and UAT which aren't shown in this screenshot.
- The QR code takes you to the latest release. Scroll down to see its attached reports.
- Note the triangle to expand/collapse the reports
:::
